# Lorcán O'Neill

> Personal website of Lorcán O'Neill (Lor), an Irish creative and commercial professional who spent nearly nine years living and working in the Netherlands.

- Currently on the commercial side of Arkintel, a Dutch AI technology company.
- Over 13 years across design, communications, business and technology.
- Author of eight books; has also built apps and made music videos.
- Brands and organisations he has worked for and with: Arkintel, Heineken, Formula 1, UEFA, Just Eat, ATPI, Savvy Lab, HTM, Brandit, The Ocean Race.
- Contact: lorcancreative@gmail.com

## Pages
- Home: introduction
- About: his story in his own words
- Experience: the roles and skills across design, communications, business and technology
- Work: the brands and organisations above
- Thoughts: short notes on technology, AI, creativity and business
- Contact: email
